req.title: DELETE is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 on second and subsequent DELETE calls for the same playerId.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-030 requires DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} to be idempotent: first call returns 204, second and subsequent calls return 404. The endpoint uses squad_number as the natural key. Tests must cover: (1) positive — first DELETE returns 204, second DELETE returns 404 (state transition); (2) negative — DELETE on a non-existent squad_number returns 404 immediately; (3) boundary — DELETE on the lowest squad_number in the dataset (1) then re-DELETE returns 404; (4) additional STC — three consecutive DELETEs all return 404 after the first. The SUT uses FastAPI TestClient in-process. The pre-loaded DB has squad numbers 1–26. Mutation resilience: exact status code assertions (204 vs 404), exact call counts, no >= comparisons.

tests.name: test_delete_idempotent_first_204_second_404
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (pre-loaded fixture)
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
expected: First DELETE returns HTTP 204 No Content
Second DELETE returns HTTP 404 Not Found
trace: R-PLAYER-030: DELETE is idempotent — second call must return 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_idempotent_first_204_second_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r2.status_code == 404

test_delete_idempotent_first_204_second_404()

expected: GET after DELETE returns 404 confirming resource removal
trace: R-PLAYER-030: EP — verifies state change (player removed) and idempotency via GET confirmation
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_delete_idempotent_player_gone_after_first_delete():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    rg = client.get('/players/squadnumber/5')
    assert rg.status_code == 404
    r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
    assert r2.status_code == 404

test_delete_idempotent_player_gone_after_first_delete()
